newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei expected to hover around 18,000.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei expected to hover around 18,000.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's benchmark Nikkei 225 index is expected to hover narrowly around 18,000 in Thursday's session, brokers said, with the downside supported by another leap on Wall Street overnight.

On Wednesday, the 225-share Nikkei average climbed 97.61 points or 0.54 percent to close above the psychologically important 18,000 barrier for the first time in six sessions at 18,031.20. Nikkei June futures rose 80 points to 18,040.
"Buying of battle-scarred financial sector issues is continuing and turnover is rising -- both are good signs," said Ken Ishikida, Sanyo Securities general manager.
